content.text: {"decision": "explain", "likely_cause": "Likely cause: after editing the Rate field on sales invoice:new without saving, all three sessions navigate to customer:list within about 2 to 3 seconds, so the unsaved form appears to be left behind rather than submitted.", "fix": "Fix: on the sales invoice:new screen, when the Rate input has been edited and the document is unsaved, show an unsaved-changes prompt or autosave a draft before any navigation to customer:list.", "cited_event_ids": ["570", "604", "575", "607", "576", "610"], "confidence": "med", "unsupported": ["The events do not show what triggered each navigation to customer:list, so the exit path is not confirmed.", "Whether the Rate value was ever saved or the form was otherwise submitted is not visible in the events.", "The console and visible error events in these windows are not linked to the abandonment and were not used.", "Typed values are masked and no validation state is shown, so the reason for leaving is not confirmed."]}
